shard_query: How can Praxodoro achieve an advanced Liquid Glass and modern skeuomorphic aesthetic while remaining native, accessible, performant, and maintainable on macOS?
questions_answered: What evidence-backed product, interaction, visual, accessibility, and technical design should define a best-in-class native macOS ADHD-aware focus coach?

key_findings.claim: Apple positions Liquid Glass as a functional layer for controls and navigation above content, explicitly warning against using it throughout the content layer or on every custom surface.

evidence.locator: Liquid Glass section: functional layer, do not use in content layer, use sparingly
Overview: custom glass and GlassEffectContainer rendering guidance

key_findings.notes: This is the main visual-system constraint and prevents undifferentiated glass-on-glass hierarchy.

key_findings.claim: A high-end native Mac implementation can combine system Liquid Glass, standard materials and vibrancy, responsive spring or morphing transitions, MeshGradient, and SwiftUI-accessible Metal shader effects without replacing the platform window or control model.

evidence.locator: Liquid Glass and standard materials; macOS blending modes
Transcript lines 205-256: colorEffect, distortionEffect, layerEffect, domain warping, TimelineView
MeshGradient overview: tessellated Bezier patches and interpolated vertex colors
Best practices: resizable windows, menu bar, keyboard, personalization

key_findings.notes: Metal effects should remain background or state feedback, not the semantic foundation of controls.

key_findings.claim: Accessibility requires complete alternate render paths: Reduce Transparency should replace translucent surfaces with solid semantic backgrounds, Reduce Motion should suppress depth/parallax and continuous effects, and increased contrast, keyboard access, and VoiceOver must remain first-class.

evidence.locator: Accessibility principles and support for system accessibility features
Indicating support: disable or change parallax, animated blur, and depth-of-field effects
Sections 9 and 11: materials, Reduce Transparency, VoiceOver, Full Keyboard Access, Reduce Motion, Bold Text, Increase Contrast

key_findings.notes: The accessible version must preserve meaning and hierarchy, not merely turn animation speed down.

key_findings.claim: Third-party effect packages are best treated as optional, bounded tools: Pow offers transitions and value-change effects, Vortex offers cross-platform particles, Inferno provides inspectable SwiftUI Metal shader examples, and Glur specializes in progressive Metal blur.

evidence.locator: README Overview, Change Effects, and Transitions
README: high-performance particle effects and supported platforms
README: Metal shaders for SwiftUI and macOS example project
README: progressive blur using SwiftUI shader API on macOS 14+

key_findings.notes: A dependency review and prototype benchmark must precede adoption.

key_findings.claim: The recommended visual architecture is advanced hybrid skeuomorphism: a living ambient content field, solid or standard-material instrument panels, refractive glass controls and navigation, tactile inset and raised surfaces, and rare particle or shader celebrations tied to meaningful state changes.

evidence.locator: Hierarchy between Liquid Glass functional layer and standard-material content layer
Best practices: purposeful and optional motion

key_findings.notes: The visual result can be maximal in craft while selective in where glass and motion appear.

contradictions.claim_topic: Whether an extremely advanced interface should apply Liquid Glass throughout the product

positions.label: maximal-glass
positions.summary: The product direction asks for an unmistakably rich Liquid Glass and skeuomorphic visual identity.

positions.label: selective-glass
positions.summary: Apple recommends Liquid Glass as a sparse functional layer and warns against using it throughout content.

contradictions.adjudication: Use maximal craft, not maximal glass coverage. Concentrate refraction and morphing in navigation and controls; use tactile, dimensional, high-fidelity standard-material content surfaces and an ambient Metal field for richness.
contradictions.residual_uncertainty: The exact visual intensity and acceptable motion budget require mockups, accessibility variants, and performance prototypes.
contradictions.notes: This preserves the requested non-minimal identity while following the platform hierarchy.

next_queries: Benchmark native glass plus one ambient Metal shader at 60 and 120 Hz on representative Apple Silicon Macs.
Audit Pow, Vortex, Inferno, and Glur licenses, transitive dependencies, release recency, and reduced-motion behavior.
Generate three distinct visual direction mocks using the same product flow and test hierarchy under Reduce Transparency.
summary: The strongest feasible direction is native-first hybrid skeuomorphism: selective Liquid Glass for functional layers, dimensional standard-material content surfaces, and carefully bounded Metal or particle effects. Accessibility alternate paths and Mac platform conventions are architectural requirements, not finishing polish.
